content.title: Contour Companion Orbit | Seated Identity, Graphic Spread and Face Return
content.summary: A cyan-tailed companion orbits an adult sound designer and locally brightens contour stripes. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One clearly adult character and all identity anchors persist. + One companion follows a complete traceable orbit. + The companion never merges with the body or clothing. + Character reactions remain small and temporally follow proximity. + The terminal full-body frame restores the opening spatial balance.
quick_start.recommended_input: Hold one original adult animated sound designer seated diagonally in a charcoal dress against a pure black stage. Bring one small black companion with a cyan translucent tail from behind the right shoulder. Let the companion exit behind the left arm, dim the stripes to their opening level and hold the same seated adult figure.
required_anchors: One clearly adult identity and one fixed pose anchor the sequence.
One distinct companion follows a continuous orbit and never merges with anatomy.
The black stage and framing remain unchanged.
The companion exits and the subject returns to a stable material state.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: A cyan-tailed companion orbits an adult sound designer and locally brightens contour stripes. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: 在纯黑舞台固定同一成年动漫人物的坐姿和灰色服装，让黑青色浮游伙伴绕过肩、胸和手侧；伙伴经过时，细条纹只在邻近身体表面短暂传播，离开后恢复原材质。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One clearly adult identity and one fixed pose anchor the sequence.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One clearly adult identity and one fixed pose anchor the sequence."

invariants.rule: One distinct companion follows a continuous orbit and never merges with anatomy.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "One distinct companion follows a continuous orbit and never merges with anatomy."

invariants.rule: Surface stripes respond locally to companion proximity.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "Surface stripes respond locally to companion proximity."

invariants.rule: The black stage and framing remain unchanged.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "The black stage and framing remain unchanged."

invariants.rule: The companion exits and the subject returns to a stable material state.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The companion exits and the subject returns to a stable material state."
